meta.title: Clinic Policies — Cottage Aesthetics
meta.description: Booking, deposit, cancellation and late-arrival policies for Cottage Aesthetics, Hartlebury.

pageHero.title: Clinic Policies
pageHero.tag: A little clarity so your visit is relaxed and stress-free.

draftFlag: Draft policy text — placeholder figures below (deposit amount, notice period). Purdi to set her actual terms before launch.

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.body: A small deposit may be required to secure your appointment. This is deducted from the total cost of your treatment on the day.

cancellations.title: Cancellations & rescheduling
cancellations.body: Please give at least [48 hours'] notice if you need to cancel or rearrange, so the appointment can be offered to someone else. Cancellations with less notice may result in the deposit being retained.

lateArrivals.title: Late arrivals
lateArrivals.body: Appointments are never rushed, so timing matters. If you arrive late, your treatment may need to be shortened to protect the following client's appointment, or rearranged where necessary.

prescriptionTreatments.title: Prescription treatments
prescriptionTreatments.body: Prescription treatments (such as anti-wrinkle injections) require a face-to-face prescriber consultation to assess suitability and cannot be booked directly online.

comfortSafety.title: Your comfort & safety
comfortSafety.body: If you feel unwell, or have any concerns before your appointment, please get in touch — your wellbeing always comes first, and there's never any pressure to proceed.
